vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: cn-diet-tracker
Version: 1.0.0

The cn-diet-tracker skill is a legitimate tool for logging food intake and calculating calories. The Python script (scripts/diet.py) performs basic CRUD operations on a local JSON file within the designated workspace and contains no network activity, obfuscation, or suspicious execution patterns.

llm.summary: The skill's code and runtime instructions match its stated purpose (local diet tracking), request no credentials or network access, and only read/write a local JSON file.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (Chinese diet tracker) align with the included code and SKILL.md. Required capabilities are minimal and appropriate: local add/today/week/target operations implemented in scripts/diet.py.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md only instructs running the included Python script and describes local storage (~/.qclaw/workspace/diet.json). The instructions do not ask the agent to read unrelated files, access environment variables, or send data externally.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec is present (instruction-only plus included script). No network downloads or package installs; the code is bundled with the skill. This is low-risk from an install perspective.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No environment variables or external credentials are requested (appropriate). Note: the script writes plain JSON to ~/.qclaw/workspace/diet.json — this is reasonable for local storage but is unencrypted and may contain sensitive dietary notes if the user adds them.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Skill is not forced-always and uses normal model invocation. It only writes its own data file and does not modify other skills or system-wide configs.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: The skill appears coherent and only stores data locally in ~/.qclaw/workspace/diet.json; it does not use network calls or request credentials. Before installing, consider: (1) review or run the bundled scripts locally to confirm behavior, (2) be aware the data is stored unencrypted in your home directory — treat it as plain text and set file permissions as needed, (3) the script does not create the workspace directory explicitly (it may error if ~/.qclaw/workspace doesn't exist), and (4) if you need stronger privacy, modify the code to encrypt the file or change the storage location. If you want, I can suggest small code edits to create the workspace directory or add basic encryption.
